section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (referred to as "the present study") that recruited only women via Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) and a small U.S. undergraduate psychology participant pool, using an online SurveyMonkey questionnaire. After exclusions for failed attention checks and missing data, the final sample was 263 women (221 MTurk, 42 undergraduate), mean age 35.26 years (SD = 12.42), mean BMI 26.23 (SD = 6.45), and 77.9% identified as White; educational breakdowns are reported and were used to compute 86.6% with some college or higher.
